data.name: Warehouse.Exception.Hint.PostingRefused
data.value: The stock refused this confirmation and it is not closed yet. Open the task: retry, mark it as moved back or confirm again.

data.name: Warehouse.Exception.Hint.PostingPendingLong
data.value: The stock has not answered this confirmation for longer than the waiting limit. Open the task and retry it.

data.name: Warehouse.Exception.Hint.PostingIntegrityError
data.value: The movement found for this confirmation does not match it. A supervisor reconciles it on the task.

data.name: Warehouse.Exception.Hint.DispatchNotSeen
data.value: The outbound has been ready to ship longer than the dispatch limit and no dispatch was seen. Check the shipment on the outbound.

data.name: Warehouse.Exception.Hint.ReservationReleasePending
data.value: The outbound is shipped or cancelled but this allocation's reservation is not released yet. The maintenance service retries it.

data.name: Warehouse.Exception.Hint.ShortDispatchUnresolved
data.value: Less was issued than picked and the rest could not be put back automatically. The record stays while the Staging stock does not match; correct it with a stock movement or a count.

data.name: Warehouse.Exception.Hint.AllocationOrphanSuspected
data.value: The allocation failed after some reservations were already made. The maintenance service releases them by key; the record leaves when all are released.

data.name: Warehouse.Exception.Hint.ReservedLotUnderRecall
data.value: The lot of this allocation is under recall; while it is reserved the recall quarantine is blocked. Cancel the outbound, then retry the quarantine in Recall.

data.name: Warehouse.Exception.Hint.AllocationStuck
data.value: The allocation has not completed for longer than two maintenance leases. The maintenance service keeps trying; if the record stays, check the service.
